label: TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY -- NOT ALPHA EVIDENCE
purpose: Prove the production replay/decision path CAN reach signal publication -> simulated order -> simulated fill -> simulated exit -> trade ledger when given an eligible, unmodified-gate-clearing setup, and separately demonstrate a REJECTED setup and a READINESS-BLOCKED (insufficient-warmup) setup -- using the frozen, unmodified talonx_quant/{strategy,indicators,consumer,config}.py throughout. All broker interaction is the offline talonx_backtest.TradeSimulator -- no real or PAPER broker is reachable from any code path exercised here.

case_1_eligible_long_setup_reaches_full_.evidence_source: Stage 1's fixture repair (examples/data/sample_AAPL_trade_1m.csv), reused here as the control-fixture proof rather than duplicated from scratch
case_1_eligible_long_setup_reaches_full_.injection_point_disclosure: A constructed OHLCV price/volume sequence was APPENDED to the existing fixture (not injected as a synthetic QuantSignal object) -- 3 further decline bars then an 8(+3)-bar +0.7%/bar recovery at 5,250 volume, preceded by ~9 trading days of synthetic quiet pre-roll (to satisfy the unmodified 200-bar HTF warmup requirement). This proves the harness reaches every downstream stage GIVEN a real trigger condition constructed via raw price data -- it does NOT prove QuantScanner naturally generates this exact setup from real market data (see stage2_zero_trade_diagnosis.md for the separate, real-data finding that no such setup occurred naturally in the actual AAPL Aug-Dec 2025 window).

pipeline_stages_proven.signal_publication: signal_type=macd_bullish_cross, direction=bullish, confluence_score=2 (== confluence_score_min, not weakened)
pipeline_stages_proven.simulated_order_creation: entry scheduled at next bar's open per talonx_backtest/engine.py's _PendingEntry mechanism
pipeline_stages_proven.simulated_fill: entry_price=96.1226 (next-bar open, matches TradeSimulator's documented no-lookahead fill rule)
pipeline_stages_proven.simulated_exit: exit_reason=TARGET, exit_price=99.5775 (computed target reached, not DATA_END/forced)
pipeline_stages_proven.trade_ledger: one row in *_trades.csv/*_trades.json with full geometry/R fields populated

case_2_rejected_setup.evidence_source: The SAME fixture's own pre-existing bearish macd_bearish_cross candidate at 2026-01-06 15:21:00Z (untouched by Stage 1's repair -- present in both the original and repaired fixture)
case_2_rejected_setup.outcome: confluence_score=1 (< confluence_score_min=2) -> rejected LOW_CONFLUENCE, never published, zero order/fill/ledger entry
case_2_rejected_setup.proves: a candidate that reaches strategy evaluation but fails a gate is correctly excluded from every downstream stage -- the harness does not leak a rejected candidate through to execution

case_3_readiness_blocked_setup.evidence_source: A fresh, minimal 5-bar synthetic DataFrame (2026-03-02 09:30 ET onward, 1-minute bars) fed directly through the unmodified talonx_quant.indicators.compute_indicators
case_3_readiness_blocked_setup.outcome: compute_indicators returns None (insufficient bars for RSI(14)/MACD(12,26,9)/ATR(14) -- far short of the ~14-26 bars those need)
case_3_readiness_blocked_setup.harness_behavior: talonx_backtest/engine.py line ~554-556: `if snapshot is None: return  # warm-up -- identical insufficient-data -> no-signal posture as live` -- the bar is silently skipped, generating ZERO candidates and ZERO rejection records (not even logged as a rejection -- a genuinely different, earlier-stage gate than confluence/volatility/session)
case_3_readiness_blocked_setup.proves: the harness fails closed on insufficient data exactly like the live system, never fabricating an indicator reading to force an evaluation

conclusion: All three cases behave exactly as the unmodified, frozen strategy code specifies. No harness defect was found in any of these three control cases -- see stage3_harness_before_after.md.
